long_biography.plain_text:
Football coach Roberto Mancini left his hometown of Jesi at thirteen to join Bologna's youth system. His father had arranged the trial and signed the contract because he was too young to do so himself. He made his Serie A debut at sixteen, then formed a celebrated attacking partnership with Gianluca Vialli at Sampdoria.

Away from competition, Mancini has supported UNICEF campaigns promoting vaccination and reducing child mortality. Appointed an Italian goodwill ambassador in 2014, he later visited Syrian refugee children at Za'atari in Jordan. There he joined games of football and saw the organisation's education and water projects, extending his involvement beyond fundraising appearances.

Away from competition, Mancini has supported UNICEF campaigns promoting vaccination and reducing child mortality. Appointed an Italian goodwill ambassador in 2014, he later visited Syrian refugee children at Za'atari in Jordan. There he joined games of football and saw the organisation's education and water projects, extending his involvement beyond fundraising appearances.
